legend: Subtle interstitial bone marrow infiltration by small neoplastic lymphoid cells (<<29886>>). CD20 immunohistochemistry highlights neoplastic cells in an interstitial pattern (<<29887>>). The majority of CD20-positive small lymphoid cells also express CD5 (<<29888>>). Cyclin D1 is expressed by > 30% of CD20+/CD5+ small lymphoid cells (<<29889>>). The t(11;14) translocation was demonstrated by FISH. SOX11 was negative (not shown).
